name: Clarisse
source:
Clarisse was orphaned from a young age-- with her father having died when she was very young, and her mother dying just after she was born. Due to this absence of maternity in her life, she hungers for the mere concept of motherhood. She loves her brother Conrad, her only living relative, but due to the poor circumstances of her emotional life while growing up, her attachment to him has warped over time. She is a pessimistic person and she never expects anything, but always starts with resignation. She is usually ladylike and calm, but sometimes she becomes emotionally unstable and fiercely desires her brother.
